name: Abandoned: A Tale of Forgotten Lives
source:
You play as Victor Trend, who was just scanning some rocks in an asteroid field for minerals and metals, while he chanced upon a secret abandoned base from a former empire.

An artificial intelligence contacts you and asks to provide assistance in exchange for the complete control of the base.

In the story you will discover some naughty secrets in this base, along with two main heroines.
translation:
你将扮演维克多·特伦德。他原本只是在小行星带扫描岩石，寻找矿物和金属，却意外发现了一个前帝国遗留下来的秘密废弃基地。

基地中的人工智能联系了你，请求你提供帮助，并以基地的完全控制权作为交换。

随着故事推进，你会发现基地里隐藏着一些不为人知的秘密，以及两位女主角。
